src/desktop.d.ts: Typed optional native bridge; desktop-only addition.
src/auth/tokenVault.ts: OS safeStorage wrapping of session tokens; sealed bytes remain in existing per-account IndexedDB for complete sign-out erasure.
src/application/updates.ts: Disable hosted shell updates; mirror existing call/upload/download holds to native updater.
src/application/webPush.ts: Use native notifications and disable web service-worker/FCM registration in desktop.
src/auth/socialAuth.ts: Uses the existing web PKCE receipt contract when the trusted same-origin browser handoff is available; retains legacy native callback compatibility until deployment.
src/ui/auth/SocialSignIn.tsx: Retries failed provider discovery and reports availability errors instead of silently hiding Google/Discord; preserves restart-safe native login proof exchange.
test/support/apiCalls.ts: Normalize source-relative test identifiers to slash separators on Windows; preserves delegated API contract coverage instead of skipping the test.
src/store/db.ts: Include OS-sealed session tokens in the existing persistent-key allowlist so session restoration survives a renderer restart; no account data migration.
src/sync/legacyImport.ts: Preserve the OS-sealed credential field during the existing one-time legacy data cleanup; cleanup must never erase the current account session.
src/ui/shell/Shell.tsx: Consume captured native invitation/template/message links in an already running signed-in shell, using existing pending-link workflows without reloading or interrupting calls.
public/social-auth-callback.js: Returns a desktop-initiated, matching social receipt to the browser handoff; preserves existing web BroadcastChannel/opener behavior.
src/application/discordReturn.ts: Routes only browser bridge-initiated state-bound Discord returns to Windows; existing web import stays unchanged.
src/ui/community/DiscordImport.tsx: Uses the native browser broker on desktop, supports cancellation, and completes the existing backend connection before preview/import.
src/ui/billing/CheckoutPage.tsx: Native popup return/closure triggers server verification of the saved account-owned checkout only.
src/ui/billing/AddonCheckoutPage.tsx: Uses the same server-owned purchase verification after native popup return/interruption.
src/application/prefs.ts: Sets interface direction along with locale; existing per-install language persistence remains the source of truth.
src/i18n/index.ts: Central key-based bundled catalogs, English fallback and stable reactive translation hook.
src/i18n/languages.ts: Extensible 21-locale registry, Chinese script distinction, RTL metadata and Windows system-language preferences.
src/ui/components/LanguagePicker.tsx: Adds native/name/code search while preserving accessible native selection and immediate persistence.
test/i18n.test.ts: Tests expanded locale resolution, explicit missing-key reporting, placeholders and English fallback.
src/ui/chat/MessageItem.tsx: Message text uses its own bidi direction regardless of interface language; content is untouched.
src/ui/mojo/MojoBadge.tsx: Replaces retired commercial names with a neutral legacy-membership label without changing entitlements.
src/ui/mojo/MojoGifts.tsx: Removes retired commercial plan label from legacy gifts; server retains ownership of gift rules.
src/ui/mojo/MojoPlans.tsx: Free/Plus remain the offered plans; retained legacy fields no longer display retired product branding.
src/ui/mojo/MojoPage.tsx: Uses neutral legacy-membership label for historical entitlements.
src/ui/mojo/SparkSection.tsx: Explains current Plus Sparks without marketing retired plans.
src/call/types.ts: Adds explicit quiet-media and waiting-for-media states, preserving separate call transport and encryption evidence.
src/call/rules.ts: Media counters distinguish muted publications and Opus DTX from continuously expected video; silence no longer reports false reconnection.
src/call/security.ts: Retains valid proof for the same registered remote track while muted; removals/errors/new unproven tracks still invalidate verification.
src/call/livekitSession.ts: Samples actual unmuted remote publications to classify expected silence without resetting or bypassing the E2EE worker.
src/ui/call/callText.ts: Names the waiting-for-remote-media state without misreporting key verification.
src/ui/call/CallStage.tsx: Displays the localized waiting-for-media label, keeping actual encryption failures visible.
src/i18n/strings.ts: Adds translated waiting-for-encrypted-media text; user message contents are unaffected.
test/call-rules.test.ts: Regression coverage for remote mute/unmute, retained frame evidence, Opus DTX, and unchanged rejection of bad/new media.
src/ui/auth/AuthScreen.tsx: Shows server/passkey metadata loading failures with refresh and online recovery while retaining central WebAuthn RP/origin checks.
src/call/frameAudit.ts: Counts zero-length DTX frames separately so intentional silence neither proves a key nor creates false decryption failures.
test/call-keys.test.ts: Includes empty DTX counts in the real frame-audit regression expectations.
src/ui/auth/DeviceSetupViews.tsx: Native sign-in uses a compact method chooser and opt-in one-time encrypted key restore; preserves backend account binding, seed validation, recovery and phone SAS verification.
